description: Attribution of the documentDecisions cost, measured with pg_stat_statements rather than statement logging. Logging taxes the arm issuing more statements harder and inflates its own numerator too, so it can only bound the in-database share; this pins it.

measuredRoundTripMs.note: 5000 sequential statements through one pooled connection of the same pg driver. A floor: the guarded insert is far larger than these.

attribution.remainderNote: Building and serialising a much larger statement; the wall profile puts kysely as the largest single mover here.

caveats: The wall figures include reactor boot and migrations, which both arms pay, so the delta is valid while the absolute values are not comparable to the op-phase timings in Runs 5 and 6.
The round-trip component is an estimate from a measured floor, not a direct measurement of the guarded insert's own round trip.
Still strictly sequential: one write in flight, so the advisory lock is never contended.
